info.title: Reikun API
info.description: Semantic Japanese Dictionary & Reading Assistant — hybrid dense + BM25 search, kanji details and JLPT-calibrated grammar explanations.

get.description: Liveness only — the process is up. Dependencies are checked by /ready.

Readiness: a real query against the Qdrant collection.
503 when Qdrant is unreachable or the collection is missing/empty.

503.description: Qdrant unreachable, or the collection is missing/empty

get.description:
Same pipeline as the dictionary UI: rewrite → route → retrieve.
Results carry `ruby` parts for furigana rendering; Japanese sentences that
decompose into word units come back in `segments` (the "parsed as" chips).

get.description:
A random kanji that is itself a JMdict headword — the shuffle button's
pick. Same rules as the UI: frequency-ranked pool, optionally restricted
to a JLPT level, up to 8 headword-verified tries then an unchecked pick.

parameters.name: level

schema.description: Prefer kanji tagged at this JLPT level (falls back to the common pool)
schema.title: Level

parameters.description: Prefer kanji tagged at this JLPT level (falls back to the common pool)

get.description:
Selectable values + counts for each /kanji/group key — the data behind
the browse pickers on the kanji-group page (stroke counts 1-34, school
grades, JLPT levels, cumulative top-N frequency bands).

Browse the KANJI of one metadata group — the click target of the kanji
card's badges ("8 strokes", "Grade 3", "JLPT N4"). Pages of characters,
frequency-ranked most-common first; `total` drives Prev/Next pagination.

parameters.name: value

schema.description: Group value - stroke count (1-34), KANJIDIC2 grade (1-6), old-scale JLPT level (1-4), or a cumulative frequency band (top-N kanji by corpus rank, for by=freq)
schema.title: Value

Facet list of source languages for the borrowed-words browse —

get.description:
One page of Japanese words borrowed from `lang` (a JMdict lsource code,
e.g. `spa`, `eng`, `chi`), ranked by corpus frequency.

502.description: Qdrant unreachable while building the facet index

post.description:
Server-sent events: `data: {"text": "…"}` chunks as the LLM streams them,
then `data: {"done": true, "explanation_id": …, "latency_ms": …}`.
Thumbs up (+1) / down (-1) on a search or an explanation.

DialectLabel.title: DialectLabel
DialectLabel.description:
One JMdict ``<dial>`` dialect tag: entity ``code`` (ksb, rkb, …) and
its English ``name`` ("Kansai-ben").

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: FastAPI's HTTPException body — declared so non-422 errors show up in the schema.

EtymologySource.title: EtymologySource
EtymologySource.description:
One JMdict ``lsource`` item, display-enriched: ``label`` is the English
phrase ("From Portuguese"), ``tag`` the BCP-47 ``lang`` attribute for the
source form (None → render without a lang tag).

InflectionRow.title: InflectionRow
InflectionRow.description: One row of a verb/adjective conjugation table.

KanjiGroupEntry.title: KanjiGroupEntry
KanjiGroupEntry.description:
One kanji of a same-metadata group (strokes/grade/JLPT) on the
/kanji-group browse page — glyph, gloss and enough metadata for a grid
card; the full card is a click away (search the literal).

KanjiGroupValue.title: KanjiGroupValue
KanjiGroupValue.description:
One selectable value of a /kanji/group facet (stroke count, grade,
JLPT level or a cumulative frequency band) with its kanji count — drives
the browse pickers.

KanjiHover.title: KanjiHover
KanjiHover.description: Compact card for kanji-in-text hover tooltips (batch endpoint).

MetaBadgeGroup.title: MetaBadgeGroup
MetaBadgeGroup.description:
Browse key for a *clickable* badge — strokes/grade/JLPT badges link to
/kanji/group so the card can list words of the same metadata group.

ReadingChip.title: ReadingChip
ReadingChip.description: One on/kun reading; `okurigana` is the part after KANJIDIC2's dot (た.べる).

RubyPart.title: RubyPart
RubyPart.description: One display segment of a headword: `rt` carries the furigana when set.

too_long.title: Too Long
too_long.description: The character cap the query exceeded

SearchMeta.title: SearchMeta
SearchMeta.description:
Per-request diagnostics. `route` is set in auto mode. On a cache hit
the timing fields describe the original computation; on a `too_long`
rejection they are absent — the pipeline never ran.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description: One word unit of a parsed Japanese sentence (a chip).

SenseResult.title: SenseResult
SenseResult.description:
One JMdict ``<sense>`` — a single meaning with everything JMdict
scopes to it. ``glosses`` are the English translations; ``pos``/``misc``
are the coarse tag lists (badge-priority ordered); ``field`` domain
labels; ``dial`` dialect labels; ``s_inf`` usage notes; ``xrefs``
dictionary cross-references; ``stagk``/``stagr`` the kanji/reading
forms this sense is restricted to; ``examples`` sentence pairs.

StrokeData.title: StrokeData
StrokeData.description: KanjiVG stroke order as sanitized data — the frontend draws the SVG.

VariantForm.title: VariantForm
VariantForm.description:
One written form (k_ele) in the variant-forms block: ``form`` is the
keb, ``readings`` the readings JMdict binds *specifically* to it
(re_restr — empty when unrestricted), ``labels`` its ``ke_inf`` codes
(sK search-only / rK rare / ateji / io / iK / oK / ik).

Variants.title: Variants
Variants.description:
Written-form ↔ reading pairings (JMdict re_restr/re_nokanji +
ke_inf), computed in retrieval so both UIs render identically.
``forms`` one row per keb; ``readings`` the unrestricted readings that
apply to every form; ``kana_only`` the re_nokanji readings that apply
to no written form.

Xref.title: Xref
Xref.description:
One JMdict ``<xref>`` — a dictionary cross-reference. ``type`` is
``see`` (general), ``ant`` (antonym) or ``syn`` (synonym); ``text`` is the
referenced headword, searchable as-is. ``seq``/``sno`` are the target
entry's sequence number and sense number — the deep-link pointer.
